definitions.explanation: The physical property of being sticky or viscous. Used to describe the texture of foods, materials, and substances.
Figuratively, the quality of being persistent and not giving up easily.

notes:
USAGE:
{粘|ねば}り{気|け} can describe both physical stickiness and figurative persistence. The pattern {粘|ねば}り{気|け}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ is common for both senses.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {粘|ねば}り{気|け}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to be sticky; to be tenacious
- {粘|ねば}り{気|け}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to become sticky
- {粘|ねば}り{気|け}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧〜: sticky ~; tenacious ~

FORMS:
{粘|ねば}り (stickiness, from ⟦{粘|ねば}る→粘る：08994_nebaru⟧ "to be sticky") + {気|け} (quality, tendency).
